paper.pdf: Locally compiled main.pdf matching current manuscript; anonymous review version.
paper.source_access: Original manuscript repository is private; the PDF and CSV snapshots used on this site are included locally.

feedback_cliff.metric: Search AVG: equal-weight mean of whois and whatis set F1, percent
feedback_cliff.note: Display values use the one-decimal values reported in Table 1.

evidence_gap.metric: Label accuracy and exact evidence-set accuracy, percent
evidence_gap.sample: Only hypotheses with nonempty reference evidence; 6 models, 13 documents, 3 hypothesis orderings

poolact_scaling.metric: GLM-5.3 majority-vote exact evidence-set accuracy, percent
poolact_scaling.note: Fixed per-agent budgets. Total budget increases with pool size. Naive uses majority-vote subsets of stored N=8 pools. Cached and PoolAct measured directly. N=1 and separate single-agent references omitted.

quickstart.install: Verified in an isolated Python 3.12 environment, including editable installation. Core dependency: NumPy.

offline_toy.artifacts: 3 valid JSON traces and CLI summary

audit_validation.result: Successful single and pool runs; finite scores and all four pool agent records.

quickstart.api_validation: OpenAI-compatible tool-calling interface inspected in release CLI and backend. No real provider API calls performed.
quickstart.repository_access: Public repository: tiannuo-yang/expgym. Initial smoke timing used the unchanged runtime from release commit 618c661.
